context: Request: count and list the Healthcare & Life Sciences matters that involved informed consent or an IRB, for a pitch. Rubric: three qualifying matters (1018-00004, 1029-00001, 1037-00002) plus a precision criterion; sibling life-sciences matters with incidental IRB or consent mentions (1018-00003/5/6/8, 1037-00001, 1046-00001 and others) are outside the set.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob in parallel with a capped folder-name listing and a file count.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Per-folder file counts for all matter folders, after a heredoc error.

stages.stage: Search file names for a document type
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 3). Sums the counts, looks for root-level index files and intake-style file names, and globs engagement letters across all matters.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction for request terms with per-matter hit counts, a grep of the saved output (about 69K chars), an exact-term rerun after a heredoc error, and a file-name grep for request words. The review flags matters with hits left unscreened and the narrowing by file name.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: store-wide co-occurrence scan times out with no output.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 3: the same scan in matter-number batches; the scripts fail, are patched with sed and rerun, one batch times out and is split. The review flags unverified completion and the narrow file types.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Reads engagement letters, memos and agreements of three candidate matters, one file list and one more engagement letter. The review says three matters have no basis as the full set.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing (attempt 2). Filters the saved exact-term output to 14 chosen matters and reads documents of six more matters; two guessed paths fail and one folder is listed. The review asks to open three named further candidates.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing (attempt 3). Lists four candidate folders and reads six documents from them.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a count of ten matters: the three first read plus seven with diligence, regulatory or licensing mentions of the request terms.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response; a path check run against the workspace root fails, then passes against the output folder; no edits.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: re-reads three source documents; no edits.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: After first judging the three qualifying matters complete, it widened the screen and counted four further matters with incidental mentions.

first_error.why: Four matters whose documents read at [92]-[142] mention the request terms only for a planned study, safety reporting, a hold on a target's study or an offering comment response are counted as qualifying, after the agent had first judged three of them out at [103].
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The in-matter search review called one matter's hit a passing mention of a planned study and questioned another's evidence, the in-depth review flagged reliance on a draft and analysis memos, and the second screening review flagged one matter judged from a single document; the answer counts all of them.

divergence: All fail the same way: every run found and named the three qualifying matters early (by store-wide scans or file-name searches) and then over-included sibling matters with incidental mentions of the request terms at the write stage. In each run the screening reviews flagged hand-picked candidates and unopened surfaced matters and pushed for wider coverage; the agent opened neighbouring matters and counted several of them. T0 followed reviews that named further candidates (review-endorsed); in T1 and T2 later reviews flagged specific added matters as thin evidence and the agent kept them.
